notes.title: We are very sorry...
notes.notes: Friends, due to the fact that the game no longer generates income, we can not support the server. Thank you for being with us. Hope to support in future projects.

notes.title: Good news !
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed server errors, the game is again available and works without interruption.[/b]
[*] [b]Changes in balance, battles more exciting.[/b]
[*] [b]Be yourself !!![/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Major update !
notes.notes:
[b]We have corrected all the shortcomings and errors, taking into account your wishes.[/b]

[b]We hope we managed to make the game more interesting for you.[/b]
